first_departure.interpretation: Residual after one unrestricted native update and one common phase alignment. Local-frame fractions decompose the Psi residual on the eight occupied sites into its rest Psi ray, the in-plane chi companion, and the remaining C3 direction.

claim_boundary: Tests the declared two-layer packet preparations for both cubical copies, both momentum signs, three axes, and a diagonal. It does not prove stability against arbitrary native-state perturbations, nonlinear finite-amplitude evolution, or external forcing. Dirac is an independent comparator only.
